procedures.title: Aortic valve replacement (AVR)
procedures.source: NACOR registry 2010–14 AVR: total case 361 ± 96 min. Split into phases using the CABG anaesthesia time; the split is an assumption.

procedures.title: Coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG)
procedures.source: Stanford 2024, 669 CABG: anaesthesia median 59 min (IQR 48–73), skin-to-skin median 247 min (IQR 205–292). Prep, closing and transfer are assumptions.
